name: Zankallala
body:
ZANKALLA
CR 13

You see a funny little person with enormous whiskers and wearing what looks like a beehive or wasp nest for a hat.

XP 25,600
CG Diminutive fey
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 19, flat-footed 23 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +9 natural, +4 size)
hp 178 (17d6+119)
Fort +12, Ref +14, Will +15
DR 10/cold iron; SR 24

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee snake staff +18/+13 (1d2+5 plus poison)
Melee 2 slams +17 (1d2+5)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks bees!, hedgehog roll, poison (snake venom)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 18, Con 24, Int 11, Wis 20, Cha 12
Base Atk +8; CMB +9; CMD 32
Feats Lunge, Combat Reflexes, Defensive Combat Training, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Nimble Moves, Weapon Focus (snake staff)
Skills Acrobatics +20, Climb +21, Handle Animal +17, Knowledge (nature) +6, Perception +20, Ride +18, Stealth +29
SQ change shape (hedgehog or giant centipede, beast shape III), chorus of birds, jerboa steed, snake staff
Languages Common, Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bees! (Su)

The zankalla can summon bees. Treat this as insect plague, summoning four contiguous swarms. It must wait 1d4 rounds before it can summon bees again.

Chorus of Birds (Su)

The zankalla is accompanied by a flock of birds.

They use Aid Another every turn to help the zankalla. Normally they sing cheerfully, but become eerily quiet when the zankalla uses Stealth.

They will not attack, but if attacked have the statistics of a raven swarm. If dispersed, they will reform in 24 hours.

Hard to Swallow (Ex)

When swallowed whole, the zankalla has blindsight 5 ft. against the swallower and deals +1d6 damage to cut its way out. Its slams are fully effective to escape.

Hedgehog Roll (Ex)

While in the form of a hedgehog, the zankalla gains a spine attack that has the same to-hit as its slam, and does 1d3+5 piercing damage.

Jerboa Steed (Ex)

The zankalla rides a loyal jerboa steed. This has the stats of a normal jerboauw with the advanced simple template, and a +4 racial bonus to saves against fear, a speed of 30 ft., and the Run feat as a bonus feat. The zankalla can use the jerboa as a mount.

Snake Staff (Su)

The snake staff is a magical quarterstaff that can bite. The snake staff, when not held, has the stats of an ordinary viper. If killed in snake form, the zankalla can call a new one in 24 hours.

Snake Venom (Su)

Snake staff—injury; save Fort DC 25; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Con damage; cure 1 save.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm or temperate forest
Organization solitary (with jerboa steed), troupe (one zankalla and 2-4 magical beasts or trained animals)
Treasure incidental

Zankallalas are creatures of surpassing might that belies their small size. Each stands less than a foot tall, covered in a ball of hair, but they commands tiny beasts as a general. The creature wears a nest of bees as a hat and carries a snake it uses like a spear or staff, and their steed is a dauntless jerboa mouse. The spirited zankallala is a foe to evil monsters and will often help those in need.

The zankallala is surrounded at all times by friendly birds, who are said to sing its praises. Its companions and armaments are creatures often regarded as among the meek, but the zankallala and its company are implacable warriors.

The zankallala is fearless in its proclamations. Though curiously armed, it is also deadly with his just its bare hands and hard head. It can also transform into a dangerous centipede or a furious hedgehog.
